home.title: Prepare for your exam with confidence
home.subtitle: Practice, mock tests and clear analysis — all in one place.

login.title: Welcome!
login.subtitle: Log in to your account or create a new one.
login.telegramWaiting: In Telegram, press the Start button and share your phone number. As soon as it is confirmed, you will be logged in here.
login.telegramWaitingConfirm: Confirmed in Telegram, logging you in…
login.telegramExpired: The link has expired. Please try again.
login.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or your backup code.
login.codeBack: Log in with a different account
login.changeHelp: Your account was opened with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute. You can also sign in with Telegram or Google.
register.usernameHelp: 3–32 characters: lowercase Latin letters, digits, dots and underscores.
register.consent: By pressing the Sign up button, you confirm that you have read the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

password.bytes: At most 72 bytes (long or special characters take up more space)
password.notNumeric: Not made up of digits only
password.noLocalWords: No platform name or sequence like 123456
password.notSimilar: Not similar to your username, name or email
password.common: Avoid common passwords (qwerty, 12345678) — the server checks this

recover.title: Reset password
recover.intro: Enter your username. If Telegram is linked, the reset link will be sent there.
recover.sent: If Telegram is linked to this username, a reset link has been sent. It is valid for 15 minutes. You can also write /reset to the bot.
recover.adminHelp: Send a request to the administrator: they will contact you and give you a temporary password.
recover.contact: How to reach you (phone or Telegram)
recover.adminSent: Request received. The administrator will contact you soon.

recoverConfirm.title: New password
recoverConfirm.help: Set a new password. You will be logged out of all devices.
recoverConfirm.done: Password updated. You can now log in with your new password.
recoverConfirm.missingToken: The link is incomplete or has expired. Please start the reset again.

onboarding.title: About you
onboarding.intro: Answer a few questions so we can analyze your results correctly.
onboarding.graduationYearHelp: The year, not the grade: for example, 2027.
onboarding.goals: Which exams are you preparing for?
onboarding.goalsHelp: You can choose several, but make one of them the main one.
onboarding.parentTelegramHelp: A @username or a t.me link. Reports about your results will be sent there.
onboarding.orgConsent: I agree that the learning center that invited me can see my results.
onboarding.orgJoined: You have joined {org}. The center can see your results.
onboarding.acquisition: Where did you hear about us?
onboarding.doneText: Your results will now be analyzed to fit you.

security.title: Security
security.sessionsHelp: Up to 3 devices per account. Sign out any device you do not recognize right away.
security.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other devices
security.twofaOff: Not enabled. If you enable it, an app code will also be requested when you log in.
security.twofaScan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis and others).
security.twofaManual: If you cannot scan it, enter the key manually:
security.backupHelp: You will need them to log in if you lose your phone. Each code works once. They are shown only now — save them somewhere safe.
security.twofaDisableHelp: To disable it, you need your password and a current code (or a backup code).
security.telegramLinkWait: Open the link in Telegram, press the Start button and confirm the connection.
security.telegramLinkConflict: This Telegram is linked to another account.
security.lastMethodHint: This is your only login method — link another one or set a password first.
security.needLogin: Please log in to your account first to see this page.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.onboardingBanner: Complete your profile to see your results.

legal.preparing: The document is being prepared. It will be published here soon.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: There is nothing at this address. Check the link or go back to the home page.

errors.unauthorized: Please log in to your account first.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalid_ticket: The temporary access has expired. Please log in again.
errors.not_required: This account does not need a password change.
errors.last_method: This is your only login method — it cannot be unlinked.
errors.consent_required: Please tick the consent box to continue.
errors.invalid_invite: The invite code is invalid, expired or already used.
errors.telegram_not_verified: Telegram has not been verified yet.
errors.telegram_in_use: This Telegram is linked to another account.
errors.no_telegram: This user has no Telegram linked.
errors.username_invalid: The username must be 3–32 characters: lowercase Latin letters, digits, dots and underscores.
errors.username_reserved: This username is reserved, please choose another.
errors.email_invalid: The email address is not valid.
errors.email_taken: This email is already used by another account.
errors.first_name_length: The first name must be 2–60 characters.
errors.last_name_length: The last name must be 2–60 characters.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters.

errors.password_too_many_bytes: The password must not exceed 72 bytes (special characters take up more space).
errors.password_repeated_char: The password must not be a single repeated character.
errors.password_too_common: This password is too common, please choose another.
errors.password_entirely_numeric: The password must not be made up of digits only.
errors.password_local_word: The password must not contain the platform name or a simple sequence.
